32: When one has a heart, 'place' has no significance at all. In fact, such a person is the place of the world. Because divinity rests in the heart, as it says (Psalms 73:26) "[G'd is] the rock of my heart." With regards to the Holy One it is written (Exodus 33:21) "There is a place with me" - that is, He is the place of the world, and the world is not his place.

So too, one who has an Israelite heart should not say that such-and-such a place is unpleasant, because place is absolutely insignificant, rather, they are the place of the world, and the world is not their place.
